title: Mix and separate
hook: Sand and water can mix in a bowl. A filter can pull them apart again.

steps.caption: Sand and water are stirred together. Now they look like one muddy mix.

nodeCaptions.mix: Sand bits and water are all swirled together.

steps.caption: Pour the mix into a filter. The filter will help sort them.

nodeCaptions.filter: The filter is ready to sort.

steps.caption: The filter lets water through. The sand stays behind — they are apart!

nodeCaptions.filter: Tiny holes let water drip. Sand is too big to pass.
nodeCaptions.apart: Sand in one place. Water in another.

steps.caption: You can stir them together again any time. Mixing and separating are opposites!

nodeCaptions.mix: Stir again and they become a mix.

takeaways: A mix is when two things are stirred together.
A filter can separate some mixes — water goes through, sand stays.
Mixing and separating are opposite ideas.

quiz.question: What does a filter do to sandy water?
choices: Lets water through and keeps the sand
quiz.explanation: The filter sorts them — water drips, sand stays.

quiz.question: When sand and water are stirred in a bowl, they are…
quiz.explanation: Stirred together means they made a mix.

quiz.question: Mixing and separating are…
quiz.explanation: Mix puts things together. Separate pulls them apart.
